name: Draft Day Sports: College Football 27
summary:
Build the college football program you've always envisioned. Draft Day Sports: College Football puts you in complete control of every aspect of running a successful program—from assembling your coaching staff and recruiting future stars to managing the transfer portal, developing players, creating game plans, and competing for conference championships and the national title.

Every decision shapes the future of your program. Scout prospects across the country, build relationships with recruits, evaluate talent that fits your system, and construct recruiting classes capable of competing with the nation's elite. Develop your roster over multiple seasons, adapt to injuries and changing personnel, and watch your players grow into All-Americans and draft prospects.

Game day is only the beginning. Manage your depth chart, install offensive and defensive philosophies, make critical coaching decisions, and adjust your strategy as opponents evolve throughout the season. Whether you're taking over a perennial powerhouse or rebuilding a struggling program from the ground up, every season presents new challenges and new opportunities.

Featuring one of the deepest franchise experiences available in sports gaming, Draft Day Sports: College Football is built for players who love long-term team building, realistic management, and the satisfaction of creating a dynasty that can dominate for decades.
